# uzc_dns_domain (Resource)

Manages a UzCloud DNS domain. There is no update endpoint, so changing any attribute recreates the resource. GET /dns/domains/{slug} requires the domain's dns_provider as a query parameter, so import needs both: use "{slug}/{dns_provider}", not the bare slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_dns_domain" "example" {
  name           = "example.com"
  cloud_provider = "dns"
  dns_provider   = "powerdns"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider` (String)
- `dns_provider` (String) e.g. "powerdns". Also required to look the domain back up via GET.
- `name` (String) Domain name, e.g. "example.com".

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project slug. Falls back to the provider's `project` default when unset.
- `region` (String) Region slug. Falls back to the provider's `region` default when unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`.
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug, used by uzc_dns_record.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_dns_domain.example <domain-slug>/<dns-provider>
```
